title: refactor(lint): move the i18n translatable-key walk from the CLI into @objectstack/lint
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBRFy5DNS3Wj4k6EK58wgcaR)_

Part of #30285

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：把「哪些翻译键存在、各自原文是什么」的遍历（`collectExpectedEntries`，2,520 行）原样从 CLI 挪进 `@objectstack/lint`，CLI 改为再导出；不改任何键、骨架或覆盖率结论。
- 为什么改：#30285 要在 Studio 里做「原文 / 译文」对照表，浏览器必须跑同一套遍历；CLI 是 Node 包，浏览器用不了，lint 已被控制台打包使用。
- 风险与回滚：纯搬移。PR 计 +879 / −682（1561 行，低于 3000 行的人工合并线，`check-governed-merges --pr 30375` 读数）。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/lint/src/i18n-walk.ts`（重命名自 `packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts`，看头部说明与删掉的尾部）、`packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-bundle-extract.ts`（保留的打包/序列化与再导出）、`packages/cli/test/i18n-bundle-extract-exports.pin.test.ts`（导出不变的钉测）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run test/i18n-bundle-extract-exports.pin.test.ts test/i18n-walk-output-parity.test.ts`，预期全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无。不是受管面，也未过行数线，席位直接落地。

## What changes

`collectExpectedEntries`, the one definition of which translation keys a stack can carry and the source text each one translates, moves from `packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts` to `packages/lint/src/i18n-walk.ts`. It is exported from the `@objectstack/lint` root together with `authorWarnedTranslationGroups`, `humanizeFieldPath` and the `ExpectedEntry` / `ExpectedEntryOptions` types. The point is that a browser can run the same walk the CLI runs. The follow-up PR for #30285 builds Studio's source-to-translation table from it.

- **Layout.** The walk keeps git's rename: `i18n-extract.ts → lint/src/i18n-walk.ts`, 17 lines added and 618 removed in place. The removed lines are the extract types and the tail: bundle assembly, `extractTranslations` and serialization. That tail stays in the CLI as a new file, `packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-bundle-extract.ts` (631 lines). It imports the walk from `@objectstack/lint` and re-exports it, so the CLI module offers exactly the names the old one did.
- **Importers.** 44 CLI importers (src and test) are repointed from `i18n-extract` to `i18n-bundle-extract`, with no other edit. `normalized-call-sites.test.ts` renames its key to the new path.
- **Ledgers and scripts.** The `action` and `view` liveness ledgers cite the walk at its new path (4 cites). `check-i18n-walk-parity.mjs` reads the walk source at its new path and adds it to its watch hints. `dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs` uses the new CLI file as its specimen. Comment-only path repoints are in `i18n-bundle-surface.mjs`, `check-i18n-bundles.mjs` and three lint files.
- **Browser default.** In a browser the walk cannot read the liveness ledger from disk (`resolveLivenessDir` answers null), so its default leaves no translation group out. That is the same set the CLI leaves out today, because the ledger warns on no translation group. A lint test pins it, so the day a group is warned, the test fails and a browser caller has to pass `warnedGroups`.
- **Changeset.** `@objectstack/lint`, `@objectstack/cli` and `@objectstack/spec` patch (spec for the liveness cites).

No key, skeleton or coverage verdict changes. The walk's code moved as is.

## Tests

- `packages/lint/src/i18n-walk.test.ts` (new): a stack with an object, a select field with options and an app with navigation yields the expected keys, each with its source text and `source`. A warned group is left out. The shipped ledger warns on no translation group (the browser-parity pin).
- `packages/cli/test/i18n-bundle-extract-exports.pin.test.ts` (new): the CLI module's runtime exports equal the old module's 12 names exactly. The walk functions are lint's own (`toBe`), not a copy. The six type exports are still offered (held by type-check).
- The CLI's existing i18n suites (about 45 files) reach the walk through the re-export unchanged.

## Acceptance notes

- **Size.** `check-governed-merges --pr 30375` puts 0 of 61 paths on the register and reads the size from the PR object, as the queue guard does: +879 / −682 = 1561, under the 3000-line human-merge line. The `--branch` forecast below counts with `--no-renames` (+3382 / −3185 = 6567) and over-reads a rename; it is not the reading the queue guard applies. lint cannot import from cli, because cli depends on lint.
- **Stale comment cites left as they are** (comments only, no behaviour): spec `i18n-resolver.ts` (3), `i18n-resolver.object-list-views.test.ts`, platform-objects `source-hash.ts`, two echo-decisions tests, cli `tsconfig.test.json` and `test-typecheck-debt.json`. They name the old path in prose, and editing them would widen the diff into packages this move does not otherwise touch.
- **Gate derivation gap (not fixed here).** `check:i18n` and `check:i18n-coverage` derive from `packages/cli/src/**` only, so a later edit to `packages/lint/src/i18n-walk.ts` alone does not derive them locally. CI still runs them. This PR touches `packages/cli/src`, so both were derived and run here.
